title: Europe’s Highest Ski Resort Named World’s Best Again at World Ski Awards 2026
headline: Europe’s Highest Ski Resort Named World’s Best Again at World Ski Awards 2026
caption:
Europe’s Highest Ski Resort Named World’s Best Again at World Ski Awards 2026

The World Ski Awards 2026 named France’s Val Thorens the World’s Best Ski Resort on Tuesday, November 10, the 11th time the resort has won the title. The global program, which recognizes excellence in ski tourism, released the winners of its 14th annual edition.

Source: SnowBrains

Photo: Florian Pépellin (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Illustrative image.

title: SnowBrains Forecast: Hokkaido Leads Japan’s Early-Week Snowfall
headline: SnowBrains Forecast: Hokkaido Leads Japan’s Early-Week Snowfall
caption:
SnowBrains Forecast: Hokkaido Leads Japan’s Early-Week Snowfall

Japan’s snow forecast favors Hokkaido from Sunday through Tuesday, with modest accumulations and falling snow levels before a brief warmup. Kiroro and Furano have the best near-term prospects, while most of Honshu stays dry.

Source: SnowBrains

Photo: Excellent moniteur de ski (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Illustrative image.

title: Alaska’s ‘Best-Kept Secret’ Ski Area Embraces a New Chapter After Gondola Setback
headline: Alaska’s ‘Best-Kept Secret’ Ski Area Embraces a New Chapter After Gondola Setback
caption:
Alaska’s ‘Best-Kept Secret’ Ski Area Embraces a New Chapter After Gondola Setback

Juneau’s Eaglecrest Ski Area has spent the past few years dreaming big. After financial struggles and the collapse of an ambitious gondola project, the resort is taking a more measured approach to future projects.

title: Zermatt
headline: Zermatt, Switzerland
caption:
Resort spotlight: Zermatt, Switzerland

The village is car-free and sits at the foot of the Matterhorn. The ski area is linked with Cervinia in Italy. Glacier terrain extends skiing deep into the season.

Photo: Roy Egloff (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Illustrative image.

title: Chamonix
headline: Chamonix, France
caption:
Resort spotlight: Chamonix, France

The town lies at the foot of Mont Blanc, the highest mountain in the Alps. The Aiguille du Midi cable car climbs from the valley to a summit station at roughly 3,800 m. Chamonix hosted the first Winter Olympics in 1924.

Photo: Webwizzard (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Illustrative image.

title: St. Anton am Arlberg
headline: St. Anton am Arlberg, Austria
caption:
Resort spotlight: St. Anton am Arlberg, Austria

St. Anton is the birthplace of the Arlberg technique, an influential early method of teaching alpine skiing. The resort is known for demanding off-piste terrain and a lively après-ski scene.

Photo: Keimzelle (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Illustrative image.

title: SnowBrains Forecast: The Week Ahead in Western North America Brings Heavy Snow to the Pacific Northwest
headline: SnowBrains Forecast: The Week Ahead in Western North America Brings Heavy Snow to the Pacific Northwest
caption:
SnowBrains Forecast: The Week Ahead in Western North America Brings Heavy Snow to the Pacific Northwest

Vancouver Island and Whistler are in line for the most snow early this week, with Tuesday also the best bet for fresh snow in the Washington Cascades. Rising snow levels will favor upper slopes as the storms turn warmer, and strong winds will pack the snow on exposed terrain on Vancouver Island.

Source: SnowBrains
